messages:
Leah: Quick alert: validation spike for fncall -> payment_intent since the 22:10 client push. Small total volume but high reject rate in us-east. :eyes:
Omar: adapters changed?
Leah: no adapter commits. Logs show amount_cents returned as a string. Example trace (redacted):
```json
{"tool":"payment_intent","result":{"status":"success","amount_cents":"1000","currency":"USD"}}
```
Leah: our strict fncall validator (canary) expects amount_cents:int so these are hard rejects.
Priya: this inflates the 'validation rejects' chart and counts against strict-validate quota. Sampling for full payloads is only 0.1% so debugging is noisy.
Nik: @payments-bot any client/server changes?
payments-bot: Client formatting update deployed 2024-04-03T22:12Z. No server changes.
Omar: client change bubbled through. Options: rollback strict canary, relax schema, or coerce in adapter.
Leah: rollback loses observability of real regressions. Prefer patch + observability.
Priya: proposal: coerce numeric-strings matching ^\d+$ -> int, emit telemetry tag 'coerced_amount_cents', and temporarily increase route-level sampling to 5% for 1 hour. That gives visibility per-route without global cost.
Nik: console needs to let ops filter validation events by tags (coerced vs hard reject). Right now console lumps all validation errors together.
Omar: I'll prepare a small PR: adapter coercion (numeric-string only) + telemetry tag + route sampling override. ETA ~45-60m. Will include example event schema and commit message.
Priya: I'll open a console ticket for a temporary panel: query validation_events where tag='coerced_amount_cents' OR reason='type_mismatch' grouped by final_model_variant. We also need final_route/model in events to avoid misattribution from multi-variant routing.
Leah: good point. Telemetry currently attributes to incoming route id which is confusing when degen variants/fallbacks are used. We should attach final_route and model_variant to validation events.
Nik: small rollout UX change: annotate rollout page that strict validation can spike during multi-variant routing and that attribution may differ until final route is resolved. Add a note for on-call.
Omar: follow-up task: telemetry pipeline change to append final_route and model_variant to validation records. Dashboard queries will need a short migration. I'll include this in the PR description.
Leah: action items: 1) Omar: PR for coercion + 'coerced_amount_cents' tag + sampling override (ETA 1h). 2) Priya: console filter/panel + query (ETA today). 3) Nik: rollout UX blurb (ETA today). 4) Leah: watch rejects and rollback canary if noise doesn't drop in 30m.
Priya: runbook snippet: when validation spike: check recent adapter/client releases, increase route sampling, look for 'coerced_*' tags, decide coerce vs rollback, and ensure validation events include final model attribution.
Omar: implement coercion narrowly: numeric-string only. Don't coerce formatted numbers like '1,000' or decimals; those should surface as rejects. Log an event on coercion.
Nik: also avoid global sampling increases; use route-level override to limit storage impact.
Leah: thanks everyone. Ping here after PR lands and after 30m of monitoring. :wave:
